title: Git commit
text: The git commit command records staged changes as a new version in the local Git repository history. Use git add before git commit.

title: Git clone
text: The git clone command downloads an existing remote repository and its commit history to your computer.

title: Git branch and merge
text: Git branches let developers work on separate lines of development. Merge integrates changes from one branch into another branch.

title: GitHub pull requests
text: A pull request on GitHub proposes a set of commits to merge. Reviewers can discuss changes, inspect code, request fixes, and approve the contribution.

title: Linux cd command
text: The Linux shell uses cd to change the current working directory. The pwd command prints your current directory, and ls lists files.

title: Linux permissions
text: The chmod command changes file mode permissions in Linux, such as allowing the owner to execute a script.

title: GitHub Actions
text: GitHub Actions runs workflows defined as YAML files in .github/workflows. CI can build, test and check contributions.
